plain: A false written statement that harms someone's good name

webster.text: A defamatory writing, L. libellus famosus.

example.quote: I presume it was not in the view of the honorable gentleman to say there is no such thing as a libel, or that the writers of such ought not to be punished.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Pennsylvania Convention, Mr. WILSON, December 1, 1787 (2d ed. 1836)
